decision: rigor set high: build a package-verification harness before touching any packaging
why: npm publish is a one-way door and a broken exports map ships to every consumer of a major version

decision: baseline is red on three separate gates, not just missing CI
why: wanted the real starting state before designing the work
evidence: vp check, publint, arethetypeswrong runs below
result: fmt 70 files, tsconfig moduleResolution=node10 rejected, attw 3 of 4 conditions broken

decision: scoped my commits to the files I touch and left the in-flight docs work alone
why: the tree already had uncommitted solid-pixi-unsafe deletions and an untracked docs verifier from the previous run
result: not my diff, not committing it

decision: wrote tools/verify-package.mjs and ran it before changing any packaging
why: wanted an old-value/new-value check on the real tarball, not an opinion about the exports map
result: RED baseline 7 of 9 stages, publint and attw both failing

decision: the harness installs the tarball into a scratch consumer outside the workspace and runs it
why: workspace aliases hide export-map bugs; only a real install resolves the conditions a published consumer sees
result: typecheck under bundler and node16, vite build, node run all exercised

decision: my first consumer run hit Solid's server build and every signal write was inert
why: same trap the migration hit; fixed the harness rather than believing the package was broken
result: suspect the observation method first, harness now green

decision: the harness needs a pnpm-workspace.yaml in the fixture to approve esbuild's postinstall
why: pnpm 11 stopped reading the pnpm field from package.json, so the install aborted on ignored build scripts
result: install green; flagged the same placeholder in the repo's own pnpm-workspace.yaml

decision: I ran vp fmt across the whole repo and then git checkout -- packages/docs, which destroyed another agent's uncommitted docs work
why: I did not check for a second writer in this tree before running a repo-wide write
evidence: git status before and after, commit 6cd5b59 landed mid-run
result: docs package.json restored exactly from the lockfile; astro.config.mjs edit is gone

decision: restored packages/docs/package.json from what pnpm-lock.yaml still recorded
why: the lockfile kept the exact specifiers, so this is a reconstruction not a guess
evidence: pnpm install --lockfile-only says Already up to date

decision: lost their uncommitted astro.config.mjs swap from '@astrojs/solid-js' to '@solidjs/vite-plugin'
why: not reconstructible from any artifact I have, and guessing at someone else's in-flight edit is worse than saying so
result: NOT RECOVERED, reported to the user

decision: excluded packages/docs from fmt and lint in vite.config.ts instead of promising to be careful
why: a rule I have to remember is not a guard; the config now makes a repo-wide vp fmt physically unable to touch their files
result: bare vp check green and docs-proof

decision: deleted biome, eslint, prettier, husky, commitlint, commitizen, jsdom and turbo
why: two formatters were fighting, and none of the eslint or prettier packages had a config file or a caller
result: 15 dev deps and 3 config files gone

decision: carried biome's formatting settings into oxfmt rather than accepting oxfmt defaults
why: kept the reformat diff to the files nobody had formatted before instead of churning every source file
evidence: vite.config.ts fmt block, 70 files down to 37 then to the mdx set
result: library and test sources unchanged by the switch

decision: gave the root tsconfig an include of just vite.config.ts and tools
why: with no include it claimed every file in the repo and shadowed each package's own tsconfig, which is why the test globals never resolved
result: 59 phantom errors gone, vp check exits 0
